HVAC Troubles? We'll Be There in a Jiffy.
CHOOSE THE HVAC CONTRACTOR YOU CAN RELY ON IN KEARNY, NEWARK, NJ, JERSEY CITY, NJ & SURROUNDING AREAS

When your HVAC system isn't working, it can become very hot or very cold in your home. The team at Service HVAC Units LLC wants to get you comfortable again as soon as possible. That's why we offer complete HVAC services for clients in and around Kearny, Newark, NJ, Jersey City, NJ & Surrounding Areas. When your heat or AC acts up, our crew will make sure it's repaired quickly and correctly.




Call 201-951-9532 now to get your free estimate on any of the services from the trusted HVAC contractor in your area.

Take Advantage Of Our Wide Range Of Services

Service HVAC Units is a licensed and certified HVAC contractor dedicated to client safety and satisfaction. Our crew is trained to install, maintain and repair all of the components in your HVAC system. Whether you need a basic tune-up or a total system replacement, we're the company to call. You can also count on us for:


Central AC installation services
AC repair
Air duct repair
Heating system upgrades
Furnace installation
HVAC maintenance




Our basic tune-up starts at $89. If you need emergency assistance, call our office at 201-951-9532 immediately.

Our Reviews
TRUST US TO MEET ALL YOUR HVAC NEEDS

The experts at Service HVAC Units have been providing HVAC services to communities in Kearny, NJ, Newark, NJ, Jersey City, NJ & Surrounding Areas for more than 20 years. Our crew is certified to work on both residential and commercial units, and we're also a certified dealer of Mr. Cool products. Our team is ready to repair your HVAC system or install a new one.




Let us know what services your home or business needs, and we'll be out as soon as possible.
